unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
scanNote:
GRAMMAR 25-BET. Unit 5 — Mandy Taylor matni va egalik olmoshlari.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 9-mashq davomi (3), 10a (matndagi 14 fe'l), 10b (7 savol-javob), 11-mashq (12 gap) — jami 36 ta javob.

⚠ 10b — JAVOBLAR MATNDAN TEKShIRILADI: uchta savolda vaqt NOTO'G'RI berilgan, shuning uchun javob 'No' bo'ladi va to'g'ri vaqt aytiladi:
  'take a break at 11?' → yo'q, soat 10 da
  'get home at 4?'      → yo'q, taxminan soat 3 da
  'waiters arrive at 6?' → yo'q, soat 7 da
  ⚠ Qolgan to'rttasida vaqt to'g'ri → 'Yes'.

⚠ 11-MAShQ — EGALIK SIFATIDAN OLMOShGA:
  my → mine · your → yours · his → HIS (o'zgarmaydi) · her → hers · our → ours · their → theirs
  ⚠ 'his' — YAGONA so'z, sifat va olmosh shakli BIR XIL. Shuning uchun 3 va 8-band boshqalardan farq qilmaydi.
  ⚠ Ega ham o'zgaradi: 'This is...' → 'IT is...'; 'Those/These are...' → 'THEY are...'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form of the present simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni Present Simple ning to'g'ri shakliga qo'ying (24-betdagi 9-mashqning davomi).
exercises.explanationUz:
Oxirgi ikki band. 12-bandda savol VA javob bor —
savolda fe'l -s olmaydi, javobda oladi.

items.textEn: 12  Yes, she ____ (take) the bus every morning at 8:30.
items.whyUz: Javobda TASDIQ gap → 3-shaxs birlik -s: takes. Savolda -s yo'q edi, javobda BOR.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni Present Simple ga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN — Mendi Teylor, kafe ofitsianti.

BU MATNDA MUHIM QIYINCHILIK BOR:
Ega har doim 3-shaxs birlik EMAS! Diqqat bilan qarang:

  BIRLIK (-s oladi):
    Mandy, She, The first customer

  KO'PLIK (-s OLMAYDI):
    The other waiters, they, The first customers

  'I' (-s OLMAYDI):
    oxirgi gapda Mendi o'zi gapiryapti

Har bir bo'shliqdan OLDIN kim turganiga qarang —
bu mashqning asosiy maqsadi.

lines.textEn: This is Mandy Taylor. She 1) ____ (work) at the Sip Café.
lines.whyUz: Oddiy -s. 'work AT' — ish joyi bilan AT.

lines.textEn: Mandy 2) ____ (go) to the café every morning at six o'clock.

lines.whyUz: Oddiy -s. 'set the tables' = stol tayyorlamoq (tarelka, vilka qo'ymoq).

lines.textEn: The other waiters 5) ____ (arrive) at seven o'clock ...
lines.whyUz: KO'PLIK ega → fe'l -s OLMAYDI. 'arrives' XATO bo'lardi.

lines.textEn: The first customers 7) ____ (come) in at about 7:30.
... and sometimes she 10) ____ (meet) her friends for lunch.
She usually 11) ____ (get) home at about 3 o'clock.
In her free time, she 12) ____ (listen) to music.
She 13) ____ (be) very happy with her job.
"I 14) ____ (get) up early every day, but I don't mind because I have the whole afternoon free."
lines.hintUz: Bu safar ega 'I' — Mendi o'zi gapiryapti
lines.whyUz: 'I' bilan -s YO'Q. 'I don't mind' = qarshi emasman. 'the whole afternoon' = butun kunduz.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions about Mandy Taylor, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda Mendi Teylor haqida namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — SAVOL MENDIGA BERILADI!
Shuning uchun 'you' ishlatiladi va javob 'I' bilan beriladi:

  SA: Do YOU go to the café at six o'clock?
  SB: Yes, I do.

Agar ega boshqa bo'lsa — 'they' bilan:
  SA: Do THE OTHER WAITERS arrive at six o'clock?
  SB: No, THEY don't. They arrive at seven o'clock.

JAVOB QOIDASI:
  Matndagi vaqt savoldagi vaqt bilan MOS kelsa → Yes, I do.
  Mos kelmasa → No, I don't. + TO'G'RI ma'lumot.

MATNDAGI VAQTLAR (tekshirish uchun):
  Mendi kafega — 6:00
  boshqa ofitsiantlar — 7:00
  birinchi mijozlar — 7:30
  tanaffus — 10:00
  ish tugaydi — 2:00
  uyga yetadi — 3:00

items.prompt: you / go to the café / at six o'clock?
items.question: Do you go to the café at six o'clock?
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Matnda: 'every morning at six o'clock' — MOS keladi.

items.prompt: the other waiters / arrive / at six o'clock?
items.question: Do the other waiters arrive at six o'clock?
items.answer: No, they don't. They arrive at seven o'clock.
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Matnda 7:00 — MOS KELMAYDI, shuning uchun to'g'rilanadi.

items.question: Do the first customers come in at 7:30?
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'The first customers come in at about 7:30' — MOS keladi. 'customers' ko'plik → they.

items.prompt: you / take a break / at 11 o'clock?
items.question: Do you take a break at 11 o'clock?
items.answer: No, I don't. I take a break at 10 o'clock.
items.whyUz: Matnda 10:00 — mos kelmaydi. Inkor + to'g'ri vaqt.

items.question: Do you finish work at 2 o'clock?
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'She finishes work at 2 o'clock' — MOS keladi.

items.question: Do you get home at 4 o'clock?
items.answer: No, I don't. I get home at about 3 o'clock.
items.whyUz: Matnda 3:00 — mos kelmaydi. Inkor + to'g'ri vaqt.

items.prompt: you / listen to music / in your free time?
items.question: Do you listen to music in your free time?
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'In her free time, she listens to music' — MOS keladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences, as in the examples.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI O'ZGARISH bir vaqtda:

  1) OLMOSH: This/That → IT,  These/Those → THEY
  2) EGALIK: sifat → OLMOSH (ot tushib qoladi)

NAMUNALAR:
  This is MY trumpet.   → It is MINE.
  Those are HER posters. → They are HERS.

EGALIK SIFATI → EGALIK OLMOSHI:
  my    → mine
  your  → yours
  his   → his      (o'zgarmaydi)
  her   → hers
  its   → (yo'q)
  our   → ours
  their → theirs

OLMOSH TANLASH:
  This / That  (birlik)  → IT IS
  These / Those (ko'plik) → THEY ARE

DIQQAT: yangi gapda OT YO'Q — shuning uchun
egalik OLMOSHI ishlatiladi.

items.whyUz: 'This' birlik → It. 'his' O'ZGARMAYDI — sifat ham, olmosh ham 'his'.

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar Book 25-bet — kafe so'zlari va egalik olmoshlari.

groups.explanationUz: Bu matnning eng qiyin joyi: ega birlikmi yoki ko'plikmi ekanini aniqlash.
'I don't mind' — juda ko'p ishlatiladigan ibora.
Ikkalasi ham 'butun' ma'nosida, lekin tuzilishi boshqa.

patterns.formula: BIRLIK ega + fe'l+S / KO'PLIK ega + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Mandy goes to the café. The other waiters arrive at seven.
patterns.exampleUz: Mendi kafega boradi. Boshqa ofitsiantlar yettida keladi.
patterns.explanationUz: Faqat he/she/it (va ularning o'rniga keladigan birlik otlar) -s oladi.

patterns.formula: Do + you/they + fe'l + vaqt? — Yes, I/they do. / No, I/they don't. + to'g'ri ma'lumot.
patterns.exampleEn: Do the other waiters arrive at six o'clock? — No, they don't. They arrive at seven o'clock.
patterns.exampleUz: Boshqa ofitsiantlar oltida keladimi? — Yo'q. Ular yettida keladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Inkor javobdan keyin TO'G'RI ma'lumot beriladi —
bu suhbatni foydali qiladi.

patterns.formula: This is + EGALIK SIFATI + ot. → It is + EGALIK OLMOSHI.
patterns.exampleEn: This is my trumpet. → It is mine.
patterns.explanationUz: Birlik: This/That → It. Ot tushadi → egalik olmoshi.

patterns.formula: Those are + EGALIK SIFATI + otlar. → They are + EGALIK OLMOSHI.
patterns.exampleEn: Those are her posters. → They are hers.
She is very happy with her job.
patterns.explanationUz:
'happy WITH' — predlog shart ('happy from' XATO).
Shunday: satisfied with, pleased with.

patterns.formula: ..., but I don't mind BECAUSE + sabab.
patterns.exampleEn: I get up early every day, but I don't mind because I have the whole afternoon free.
patterns.exampleUz: Har kuni erta turaman, lekin qarshi emasman, chunki butun kunduzim bo'sh.
patterns.explanationUz:
'I don't mind' = qarshi emasman, farqi yo'q.
'because' bilan sabab.
